en:
What are you here for today?
Did you come to beg for your life?
Ah...are you serious about killing me?

Yup, of course. 
Since I'm the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Supreme Leader<CLT=cltNORMAL>, duh.

I swore on my own title that I would protect
my organization. That's why, you must die.
<CLT=cltMIND>I can't tell...if he's serious...

Weeeell, do it already!
Get on the ground and beg like a dog!

Ooooh, I wanna see you slit your stomach too!
C'mon! Do it, pwetty pweeeease!?
If I did that, I would die!

Psh, guess I couldn't trick you.
Boooooooring.

O-kay, how about this? If you wanna live,
you gotta beat me in a game!
A game?
I accept
What kind of game?
Killing me was just a joke, right?
Are you unsure of something?

I didn't give you much of a choice...but
listen, this is your chance to survive.
I accept.

...Ooh, that was a quick decision.
I didn't see that one coming.

Veeery intriguing, Shuichi!
Keep it interesting for me, kay?
What kind of game?

Russian Roulette, but with a bullet 
in every chamber! You go first!
What!? I would die for sure!

Well, you never knooow!
The bullet could get jammed.
...Revolvers don't jam.
Aw, I guess you knew that already!
I am not playing Russian Roulette!

Fine, fine! Geez, you're being pretty picky
for someone who's about to be killed here.
Killing me was just a joke, right?
I hate lies and jokes.

...You're going to tell me
you're lying again, aren't you?
Yup, I'm lying!

Kokichi...
Can we talk seriously for once?

Rude! I *am* being serious, y'know?
I'm definitely planning to kill you!
And if you don't want that to happen...

Then you gotta play a Shadow Game!
It's time to du-du-du-du-du-du-du-duel!
A...duel? Shadow Game...?

Hmhmhm... Yes, the loser's soul will get 
sent to the Shadow Realm...

We each pull one card from this deck,
and whoever has the largest number wins!

<CLT=cltMIND>Where did you get
the cards from!?
It's my turn! I draw a card!

...Hehehe, the power of the Heart of the Cards
is strong within me.

I drew the number 7! It is neither high nor low!
The possibility of you winning drops to 50%!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi's in an odd mood...
I wonder what's going on.

Huhuhu... I end my turn.
Now, it's your turn!

Draw your card,
and unleash your attack!
Ah, okay...
Ah. A 7.

Wh-What!? How can this be!?
You drew the Monster Reborn card!?

Nee-heeheehee...
You truly are an amazing duelist, Shuichi.

You aimed for a tie instead...
You intrigue me.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wouldn't say I did
that intentionally...

But, this is the end for you!
I'd let you live *only* if you had beaten me!

You only have three events left in your life,
so you better entertain me until then!
Nee-heehee...
<CLT=cltMIND>Three events? What three events?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kokichi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>I returned to my room,
mind and body exhausted...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi...are you just
toying with me...?
